subject: *: confine txn assertion API usage (#65642)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent for kv/store/table changes. The commit cleanly separates assertion operations from generic key flag ops by introducing `kv.AssertionOp` + `MemBuffer.UpdateAssertionFlags`, removes `Transaction.SetAssertion`, and updates TiKV unionstore driver mapping plus table mutation callsites to use a local `setAssertion` helper that preserves the prior “assertion flags are set-once per key per txn” behavior (checks `GetFlags`/`HasAssertionFlags` before setting). Error handling remains consistent because `MemBuffer.GetFlags` converts tikv not-found via `derr.ToTiDBErr` to `kv.ErrNotExist`, which is what the new `kv.IsErrNotFound` check expects. No Blocker/High correctness/consistency/txn-behavior issues found. Checked later history up to `remotes/upstream/master`: no subsequent changes to `pkg/kv/assertion.go`, `pkg/store/driver/txn/unionstore_driver.go`, or `pkg/table/tables/assertion.go`.
